about.title: Design that quietly improves the way you live.
about.body1: Founded in 2002 in Jersey City, New Jersey, Gotch Studio creates interiors that feel collected, calm, and deeply personal. We believe luxury is measured not in excess, but in how a space makes you feel the moment you walk in.
about.body2: From riverfront lofts to Mediterranean retreats, our full-service practice blends European refinement, the science of well-being, and a reverence for natural materials and craft.

meta.title: About — Gotch Studio
meta.description: Founded in 2002 in Jersey City, Gotch Studio is an award-winning interior design firm working across the US and internationally.

hero.title: Two decades of timeless design.
hero.intro: Since 2002, we have shaped homes and spaces that balance beauty, well-being, and a quiet sense of permanence.

story.title: From a small Jersey City studio to a global practice.
story.body1: Gotch Studio began in 2002 with a single conviction: that thoughtful design can measurably improve daily life. What started as a boutique practice on the Hudson has grown into an internationally recognized firm working across all 50 states and on four continents.
story.body2: Through every project, our philosophy has stayed constant — listen deeply, design with restraint, and craft interiors meant to be loved for decades, not seasons.
story.body3: Today our multidisciplinary team brings together interior architecture, neuroaesthetics, sustainability, and a global network of artisans under one roof.

philosophy.title: Three principles guide everything we make.

sustainability.title: Sustainability
sustainability.body: We design to endure — favoring natural, healthy materials, vintage sourcing, and craftsmanship built to be repaired rather than replaced.

wellness.title: Wellness
wellness.body: Drawing on neuroaesthetics, we tune light, air, acoustics, and materiality to how spaces actually make you feel.

timeless.title: Timeless Luxury
timeless.body: We design beyond trend — coherent, personal interiors that look as right in twenty years as they do today.

team.title: The people behind the work.
team.intro: A close-knit, multidisciplinary team united by craft and care.
